desc: The cleanest single artefact in the technical layer. A UNCLASSIFIED//FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY Defense Intelligence Reference Document bearing the control number DIA-08-1004-004, publication date 6 April 2010 and a 'reOD' date of 1 December 2009, prepared by the Acquisition Support Division (DWO-3), Defense Warning Office, Directorate for Analysis, Defense Intelligence Agency. The author is given as Eric W. Davis, Ph.D., EarthTech International, Inc., 11855 Research Blvd, Austin, TX 78759. The administrative note states the product is one in a series produced in FY 2009 under the DIA Defense Warning Office's Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) programme and directs correspondence to James T. Lacatski, D.Eng., AAWSA Program Manager, ATTN: CLAR/DWO-3, Bldg 6000, Washington DC 20340-5100. It also carries a copyright warning against further dissemination of the photographs in the publication - a small detail worth noticing in a theoretical physics survey. Everything a hostile auditor would demand is on the cover: agency, directorate, division, control number, fiscal year, contractor, address and named programme manager.
